# Drosophila 12S retention results

Date: 2026-09-30. Diagnostic source: a scratch copy of `ed04bde`.

**The exact historical 487 bp and 499 bp sequences are generated by the
existing bounded search, then discarded by diagnostic retention.** The
binding limit is the run marker budget's fixed share for 12S. This resolves
the immediate cause of their earlier
[bounded non-observation](UNCERTAIN_PRODUCTS_RESULTS.md); it does not establish
biological correctness or restore either sequence to production FASTA output.

## Completed replay

The replay uses the same SRR31887760 first 1M R1 records, full 21-target insect
panel, k=19, two CPUs, chunks=0, and normal inclusive defaults. A scratch
observer records each completed, in-range, repeat-withheld path's actual
oriented sequence hash, reverse-complement hash, length, encounter ordinal
and retention disposition before any retention early return. It receives no
historical sequences or hashes; identity matching occurs after execution.

All 16 searched-threshold ledgers are complete, without reaching the observer's
4,096-row or 8 MiB per-ledger limits. At 12S threshold 2, all **26 completions
have distinct oriented hashes**: three are retained and 23 omitted by the
marker cap. Exact matches are:

| Target | Historical length | Threshold | Completion ordinal | Marker occurrences | Disposition |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 12S | 475 bp | 2 | 1 | 414 | Retained positive control |
| 12S | 499 bp | 2 | 13 | 439 | Marker-cap omission |
| 12S | 487 bp | 2 | 19 | 426 | Marker-cap omission |
| 16S_2 | 590 bp | 2 | 1 | 478 | Retained positive control |

Ordinals are one-based search encounters within each target/threshold, not
FASTA ranking. Matches are full-length, same-orientation hash identities,
not merely equal lengths. The [independent outcome review](../benchmarks/benchmark_results/v3.2-inclusive-release-20260929/review/dros12s_outcome_review.json)
passes and records complete identities and evidence fingerprints. The
[local scratch assessment](../tmp/inclusive-release-20260929/dros12s/replay-v1/assessment.json)
contains the detailed ledger inventory.

## Binding budgets

These unchanged payload caps are separate from graph/search bounds and
process memory limits:

| Scope | Paths | Sequence bases | Marker occurrences |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Threshold | 32 | 524,288 | 4,096 |
| Gene | 64 | 1,048,576 | 8,192 |
| Run | 256 | 4,194,304 | 32,768 |
| Fixed run share allocated to 12S | 13 | 199,729 | **1,561** |
| 12S retained usage | 3 | 1,459 | **1,274** |

The run budget is partitioned across all 21 targets; unused shares are not
redistributed. The first three retained paths consume `414 + 427 + 433 = 1,274`
markers, leaving **287**. The exact 499 bp path needs 426 SCC-node occurrences
plus 13 collision-edge occurrences: `1,274 + 439 = 1,713 > 1,561`.
The exact 487 bp path needs 415 plus 11: `1,274 + 426 = 1,700 > 1,561`.
Both fit the threshold and gene marker caps individually, and path/base
capacity remains available at the actual omission points.

Raising only a threshold or gene cap would leave the fixed run-share limit
unchanged. Raising only that marker share would expose other existing caps.
Accounting for all preceding paths in the unchanged encounter order gives:

| Retain through completion | Paths | Sequence bases | Marker occurrences |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 13, including exact 499 bp | 13 | 6,366 | 5,572 |
| 19, including exact 487 bp | 19 | 9,301 | 8,140 |
| All 26 observed completions | 26 | 12,747 | 11,158 |

Thus retaining through ordinal 13 exceeds the current threshold marker cap;
through ordinal 19 also exceeds the allocated 13-path share; all 26 exceed
the gene marker cap. These are sums from the completed ledger, **not selected
new limits or a production policy change**.

## Compatibility, validation and limits

Production source, search order, thresholds, admission and retention settings
remain unchanged. All normal FASTA bytes, read/base/k-mer counts, gene outcomes,
threshold diagnostics and retained uncertainty provenance match the preceding
control: **nine standard and four uncertain records**. Source, binary, inputs,
control artifacts and outputs pass the required identity checks. The child
receipt confirms two CPUs and the 40 GiB address-space limit; the replay has
a 1,800-second timeout. Observer timing is not a release benchmark.

The scratch default-backend build passes formatting, Clippy, **250 unit and
29 integration tests**, including three observer controls. Eight author and
two independent Python controls pass; they cover retention omissions, exact/RC
identity, duplicates, overflow, missing/extra ledgers and retained-source
binding. See the [execution review](../benchmarks/benchmark_results/v3.2-inclusive-release-20260929/review/dros12s_execution_review.json)
and [independent controls](../benchmarks/benchmark_results/v3.2-inclusive-release-20260929/review/independent_dros_controls-v1.json).

The sequences remain repeat-uncertain hypotheses. This experiment evaluates
neither independent read support nor correct biological repeat length. Other
paths may remain beyond the unchanged graph, DFS, length and node-visit bounds.
Any retention redesign or admission change requires its own review and
comparison; the current production benchmark remains pinned to `ed04bde`.
